newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-LIPCSEI AND URBAN RETURN FOR HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIPCSEI AND URBAN RETURN FOR HUNGARY.

text.p: Midfielders Peter Lipcsei of Ferencvaros and Florian Urban of Anderlecht return to the Hungarian squad named by coach Janos Csank on Tuesday for the World Cup group three qualifier with Switzerland in Budapest on August 20th.
Lipcsei, who returned to Ferencvaros in the summer after a spell with FC Porto in Portugal, has been out of the squad for 18 months and missed most of last season through injury.
Urban missed the previous qualifier against Norway through suspension.
However experienced sweeper Emil Lorincz of MTK Budapest will miss the game through injury.
Goalkeepers: Gabor Babos (MTK Budapest), Szabolcs Safar (SV Salzburg), Zoltan Vegh (Vasas Budapest).
Defenders: Mihaly Mracsko (Gyor), Attila Kuttor (MTK Budapest), Vilmos Sebok (Ujpest), Janos Banfi (Eintracht Aalst), Attila Dragoner (Ferencvaros), Andras Kereszturi (Slovan Bratislava).

Midfielders: Tibor Dombi (Debrecen), Elek Nyilas (Ferencvaros), Laszlo Farkashazy (MTK Budapest), Gabor Halmai (MTK Budapest), Peter Lipcsei (Ferencvaros), Florian Urban (Anderlecht), Bela Illes (MTK Budapest), Tamas Sandor (Torino), Norbert Nagy (Ferencvaros), Zoltan Szlezak (Ujpest).
Forwards: Zoltan Kovacs (Ujpest), Ferenc Orosz (MTK Budapest), Gabor Torma (Roda), Laszlo Klausz (SV Salzburg).
